scheme_name: Incentives to Students who Passed the Civil Service Examination
other_conditions: Must have cleared Civil Services Preliminary, Main and Interview stages conducted by MPPSC or UPSC
Incentives are granted only for the first success at each stage; a second-time success receives 50% of the incentive amount, and no benefits are provided after a third success
benefits_summary: Financial incentives up to ₹60,000 for successful ST candidates, with reduced amounts for second-time successes and no benefits after a third success
